release_goal: first real end-to-end analysis chain, still production_ready=false

priorities.title: Canonical source status active_reviewed
priorities.acceptance: No current documentation/config outside archive/v1 uses active as the runtime activation status.

priorities.title: Package hygiene and one validation command
priorities.acceptance: No caches in release, subsystem READMEs present, full validation command passes.

priorities.title: Correct implementation documentation
priorities.acceptance: Docs match actual v2 screen names, counts and executable test baseline.

priorities.title: Document/extraction/register schemas
priorities.acceptance: All parser output validates and every text segment has stable provenance.

priorities.title: Native DOCX parser
priorities.acceptance: Five fixtures pass without OCR or code execution from document content.

priorities.title: Text PDF parser with OCR fallback
priorities.acceptance: Page anchors and confidence per segment; no hard missing finding on low confidence.

priorities.title: Real document check UI
priorities.acceptance: User can confirm extracted metadata and parsing warnings before analysis.

priorities.title: Five deterministic registers
priorities.acceptance: Role, term, definition, procedure and cross-reference fixtures pass.

priorities.title: Internal consistency engine
priorities.acceptance: Produces traceable internal_conflict/editorial findings without legal overclaim.

priorities.title: Filtered retrieval service
priorities.acceptance: Wrong year, regime and comparison source are excluded or downgraded in tests.

priorities.title: Full evidence validator
priorities.acceptance: Must is blocked on any failed source/rule/date/year/regime/hash/context/evidence condition.

priorities.title: Human approval contract
priorities.acceptance: No code path automatically sets production_approved true.

priorities.title: Immutable analysis run model
priorities.acceptance: Run stores versions/snapshot and reports partial instead of complete on phase failure.

priorities.title: Modular phases A-I
priorities.acceptance: Each phase has explicit contract/status; A,C,D,I implemented first.

priorities.title: Versioned model adapter
priorities.acceptance: Structured server-side model calls only; model cannot alter authority/status/severity gate.

priorities.title: Versioned prompt modules
priorities.acceptance: Each module outputs schema-valid JSON and has regression tests.

priorities.title: Separate demo from real runs
priorities.acceptance: Real upload never shows demo findings; demo remains permanently labeled.

priorities.title: Real phase progress and partial banner
priorities.acceptance: UI reflects actual A-I phase statuses.

priorities.title: Evidence-first finding detail
priorities.acceptance: Every real finding links exact document passage, rule and source fragment.

priorities.title: Executable golden set >=15
priorities.acceptance: Golden analyzer cases run in CI and include injection, uncertainty, cross-school and stale-hash cases.

priorities.title: Full test layers including browser
priorities.acceptance: Parser, register, retrieval, validator, analyzer, e2e and browser suites pass.
